script:
#!/bin/bash
# 只同步站主记忆档案 vault-data.js 到 VPS
# 走 GitHub contents API 的 raw 视图：raw.githubusercontent 是 CDN，覆盖同名文件后会
# 缓存旧内容（实测带 ?t= 也无效），API 端点没有这个问题。
set -u
API="https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/vault-data.js?ref=main"
EXPECT=72182
TMP=/tmp/_vault_new.js

curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" \
     -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
     -H "User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync" \
     "$API" -o "$TMP" || { echo "下载失败"; exit 1; }

SIZE=$(stat -c %s "$TMP")
echo "下载字节: $SIZE (期望 $EXPECT)"
if [ "$SIZE" != "$EXPECT" ]; then
  echo "字节数不符，未覆盖"
  grep -o '"generatedAt": "[^"]*"' "$TMP" | head -1
  exit 2
fi
grep -q 'PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256' "$TMP" || { echo "结构异常（不是加密信封），未覆盖"; exit 3; }
grep -o '"generatedAt": "[^"]*"' "$TMP" | head -1

sudo install -m 644 -o root -g root "$TMP" /var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
ls -l /var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
echo "---- 站点自检 ----"
curl -fsS "https://xinmo.work/vault-data.js?t=$(date +%s)" | head -c 120; echo
